en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a long stable courtyard lined with horses and uniformed men. On the right is a row of stables with steep, tiled gabled roofs in a Central European style; on the left and in the background are multi‑storey barracks‑like buildings enclosing the yard. The scene appears to be a military horse stable. Text is printed along the bottom margin and a red number is handwritten at the top.
